name: EuroLLM consortium (Unbabel, IST Lisbon, U. Edinburgh, ...)
Swiss AI Initiative (ETH Zurich, EPFL)
notes: Switzerland is not in the EU. Publishes a Code of Practice document (transparency and copyright) voluntarily; not a signatory of the GPAI Code of Practice.

name: Silo AI (AMD)
notes: Acquired by AMD in August 2024.

name: Aleph Alpha
notes: Definitive merger agreement with Cohere signed 2026-09-16, pending approval.

name: National Library of Norway
notes: Norway is not in the EU but in the EEA, which the scorecard counts as eu.

name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
notes: Llama 4 (April 2025) was the last open-weight Llama. The Muse line of Meta Superintelligence Labs started closed (Muse Spark, April 2026); open weights followed in the meta-models organisation: Muse Glimmer 30B (Apache 2.0, August 2026) and Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B (Muse Model License, October 2026). EU licensees contract with Meta Platforms Ireland Limited.

name: Google LLC (Google DeepMind)
notes: Subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. (US). Gemma is authored by Google DeepMind.

name: Microsoft Corporation
notes: EU AI Act summaries for Phi are issued by Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited.

name: NVIDIA Corporation
notes: Not on the Code of Practice signatory list, but publishes an AI Act training-content summary for the Nemotron 3/3.5 family.

name: Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
notes: Non-profit research institute.

name: Alibaba Cloud (Qwen team)
notes: Qwen is the model team of Alibaba Cloud, part of the listed Alibaba Group (NYSE/HKEX).

name: DeepSeek (Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.)
notes: Founded 2023 by Liang Wenfeng out of his quant hedge fund High-Flyer; press reports Liang holds a large majority after a 2026 round in which Tencent was the largest outside investor. EU authorised representative: Prighter.

name: Moonshot AI
notes: Private Beijing start-up. Investors include Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan (Long-Z) and, as reported lead of a July 2026 round, the state-backed National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund.

name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI; Z.AI Co., Ltd.)
notes: Tsinghua spin-off, listed in Hong Kong since 8 Jan 2026 (2513.HK); investors include Alibaba, Tencent, Ant Group and Saudi Aramco Prosperity7. On the US Entity List since Jan 2025 (press).

name: MiniMax (MiniMax Group Inc.)
notes: Shanghai-based, listed in Hong Kong since 9 Jan 2026 (0100.HK); Alibaba about 12.5-15% and Tencent about 2.8% per prospectus coverage. Its EU AI Act summary for M3 names Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) as provider, Prighter GmbH as EU representative.

name: Tencent (Hy / Hunyuan team)
notes: Listed in Hong Kong (0700.HK). Largest shareholder is Prosus (Naspers group, NL/ZA) with about 22.7-22.8%.

name: LG AI Research
notes: AI research arm of the LG Group; EXAONE licensor is LG Management Development Institute Co., Ltd. K-EXAONE developed under Korea's government Sovereign AI Foundation Model programme (government-provided GPUs).

name: Upstage
notes: Seoul-based AI company. Solar Open 2 built in the MSIT/NIPA Sovereign AI Foundation Model Project (GPU Track); clusters operated by Lablup.

name: NAVER Cloud / NAVER Corp.
notes: HyperCLOVA X SEED licensed jointly by NAVER Corp. (IP holder) and its affiliate NAVER Cloud Corp. (operator). Eliminated from Korea's sovereign AI project in Jan 2026 after reusing Qwen2.5 vision-encoder weights (press).

name: LLM-jp / National Institute of Informatics (NII)
notes: Public research institute; models developed by NII's Research and Development Center for Large Language Models (LLMC). Trained on AIST's ABCI 3.0.

name: Swallow LLM (Institute of Science Tokyo / AIST)
notes: Academic project of Institute of Science Tokyo (Okazaki and Yokota labs) with AIST; public funding (MEXT, NEDO, AIST); Hub org still named tokyotech-llm.

name: Preferred Networks (PFN)
notes: Tokyo-based private company. PLaMo 3 NICT base models co-developed with NICT (national research institute); flagship PLaMo 3.0 Prime is closed-weight. Chosen over Sakana AI, which has no current open-weight LLM flagship (only research checkpoints).

name: Sarvam AI
notes: Bengaluru-based startup; Sarvam 30B/105B trained on compute provided under the government IndiaAI Mission.

name: AI Singapore
notes: National AI programme funded by the National Research Foundation Singapore (and IMDA under the National LLM Funding Initiative); SEA-LION models adapt foreign bases.

name: Technology Innovation Institute (TII)
notes: Government research institute: part of Abu Dhabi Government's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC).

name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) / Institute of Foundation Models (IFM)
notes: Public graduate AI university established by the Abu Dhabi government (2019). LLMs are released by its Institute of Foundation Models (IFM, founded May 2025); the former LLM360 Hub org now redirects to IFM. Jais 2 (inception42, G42/Inception with MBZUAI and Cerebras) is a separate line, not scored here.

name: AI21 Labs
notes: Privately held. Acquisition talks with Nvidia (Jan 2026) and Nebius (Apr 2026) ended without a deal; in May 2026 AI21 cut ~61% of staff and said it would halt development of the Jamba model family.

name: Cohere
notes: Privately held. Definitive business combination agreement with German Aleph Alpha signed 2026-09-16 (pending regulatory approval); Cohere is the acquiring party, combined company to operate as Cohere, dual HQ Toronto/Berlin. EU AI Act provider entity for Command A+ is Cohere Germany GmbH.

name: OpenEuroLLM consortium (coordinated by Charles University; co-led by AMD Silo AI)
notes: EU Digital Europe Programme project (grant 101195233, STEP Seal), started 2025-02-01; 20 partners incl. universities, EuroHPC centres and companies. Coordinator Jan Hajič (Charles University, ÚFAL); co-lead Peter Sarlin (AMD Silo AI, owned by AMD, US).

name: PLLuM / HIVE AI (Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs, NASK and partners)
notes: Developed by the PLLuM consortium (2024) and since 2025 under HIVE AI, an alliance of Polish research institutions and public digital-service bodies (contact hive@nask.pl); funded by the Minister of Digital Affairs (subsidy 1/WII/DBI/2025, ~18.5 M PLN). The AI Act summary names Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji as provider.

name: OpenGPT-X (Fraunhofer IAIS/IIS, Forschungszentrum Jülich, TU Dresden, DFKI)
notes: Research project funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action (BMWK); led by Fraunhofer IAIS.

name: Danish Foundation Models (SDU, Aarhus University, University of Copenhagen, Alexandra Institute)
notes: Consortium of four Danish institutions; funded by the Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Mimir is led by the SDU lab of Peter Schneider-Kamp (GitHub schneiderkamplab hosts the HRM-Text training fork).

name: INSAIT (Institute for Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Technology), Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"
notes: Public research institute at Sofia University, founded in April 2022 in partnership with ETH Zurich and EPFL. BgGPT 3 thanks Google for GCP credits and donations. Also publishes MamayLM (Ukrainian, Gemma 3 based).

name: University of Ljubljana (CJVT / Faculty of Computer and Information Science)
notes: Public university. GaMS developed in the PoVeJMo programme (ARIS, NextGenerationEU); NVIDIA Sovereign AI initiative provided DGX Cloud Lepton access. GaMS-Beta Hub org (translator models) not verified as official, not listed.

name: Athena Research Center / Institute for Language and Speech Processing (ILSP)
notes: Public research centre (Athena RC, Greece). Training on AWS made available via GRNET under the OCRE Cloud framework.

name: University of Tartu (TartuNLP), with TalTech (TalTechNLP)
notes: Public university; EstLLM co-developed with TalTechNLP (Tallinn University of Technology), funded by the Estonian Ministry of Education and Research (Estonian Language Technology Program 2018-2027). Also publishes Apertus-EstLLM-8B (Swiss Apertus base).

name: AMALIA consortium (NOVA University Lisbon, IST, U. Coimbra, U. Porto, U. Minho, FCT)
notes: Consortium of Portuguese public universities and research centres with the Foundation for Science and Technology (FCT), funded by the Government of Portugal. Distinct from the EuroLLM consortium (eurollm), whose EuroLLM-9B it continues; IST is in both.

name: PORTULAN CLARIN / NLX group, University of Lisbon
notes: NLX - Natural Language and Speech Group, Faculty of Sciences, University of Lisbon; PORTULAN CLARIN research infrastructure (FCT-funded).

name: HiTZ Center, University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU)
notes: Public university research centre (HiTZ and IXA group).

name: HPLT project (Language Technology Group, University of Oslo)
notes: EU Horizon Europe project (grant 101070350) consortium of universities; NorOLMo built by the University of Oslo LTG. Norway is in the EEA, which the scorecard counts as eu.

name: Almawave
notes: Member of the Almaviva Group (Italy). Since September 2026 the Velvet models sit in Almawave Labs S.r.l., a single-shareholder company under the management and coordination of Almaviva S.p.A.; the former Almawave S.p.A. (Euronext Growth Milan) is merged into the parent.

name: Fastweb (Fastweb + Vodafone)
notes: Single-shareholder company under the direction and coordination of Swisscom AG (Switzerland).
